docs/haskell.md.transformation: Adapted as reference and generated-game guidance with source-first explanation, public-boundary checks and targeted rule review; replaces a mandatory README inventory with a deliberate learning route and consolidates Paper Circuit Undo snapshot rationale.

references/lantern/src/Lantern.hs.transformation: Preserved checked construction and the public API; legal and advance now share one checked shifted-world candidate. Replaced guarded partial list indexing with total position traversal and retained departing row identities alongside their mask indices.

tools/quantity/oracle.py.transformation: Preserved classification, expected results and vector generator; removed obsolete path-bound executable runner and imports.

docs/guarantees.md.transformation: Adapted as a scoped research-result reading guide: preserves quantified contracts, trusted assumptions, failed division diagnostics, counterexamples and source/model limits; routes duplicated result/count inventories to the unchanged historical receipts and separately identified public reruns.

references/tapline/src/Tapline/Domain.hs.transformation: Named due-boundary processing and documented frame ordering without changing transition cases.

references/tapline/src/Tapline/View.hs.transformation: Documented pure rendering projection; rendering logic unchanged.

references/garden/src/Garden/Clock.hs.transformation: Documented clock debt; scheduler rules unchanged.

references/garden/src/Garden/Input.hs.transformation: Reject out-of-board pixels before coordinate subtraction, avoiding Int wrap; ordinary board mapping retained.

references/river/src/Life/Domain.hs.transformation: Retains the original public API as a facade over hidden Core, Snapshot, Presentation and Journey implementation modules. Earlier transformations added domain-rule and save-boundary Haddock, pinned Ormolu layout, named private Game fields and overnight state dependencies; their comparison against c44f31a remains recorded in research/readability/river-refactor.md.

references/river/src/Life/Internal/Core..transformation: Split the domain state, read-only queries, geometry, target selection and pure transitions from the refactored Life.Domain. Shared build-site and overnight drying policies with snapshot validation; retained game rules, messages and effect order. The module is hidden by the library.

references/river/src/Life/Internal/Snaps.transformation: Split the private version-one raw save types, codec and validators from the refactored Life.Domain. Named RawSave construction fields and reused one reconstructed candidate for validation and restoration while retaining the save grammar and ordered diagnostics. The module is hidden by the library.

references/river/src/Life/Internal/Prese.transformation: Moved interaction prompts, clock text, task progress, journal and factual night-report projections unchanged from the refactored Life.Domain; target selection remains shared with the command rules. The module is hidden by the library.

references/river/src/Life/Internal/Journ.transformation: Moved breadth-first route traversal and authored scenarios unchanged from the refactored Life.Domain. Both still use legal commands rather than direct state construction. The module is hidden by the library.
